description: This file is a Node.js script, specifically an ECMAScript Module (with .mjs extension), designed to interact with GitHub security advisories via the GitHub CLI. It includes functions for argument parsing, remote repository parsing, and making API requests to update security advisories with vulnerability information, including reading a description file and patching advisory data.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into an object.

methods.name: runGh
methods.description: Executes a GitHub CLI command synchronously and returns stdout.

methods.name: deriveRepoFromOrigin
methods.description: Derives the GitHub repository name from the git remote URL.

methods.name: parseGhsaId
methods.description: Extracts the GHSA ID from a given string.

methods.name: writeTempJson
methods.description: Writes JSON data to a temporary file and returns its path.
